shortDescription: Three z-levels (sky/surface/basement) in ONE banded RimWorld Map joined by synthetic RegionLink wormholes, so hauling/needs/work/storage come free from vanilla. Per-band biomes, Caverns basements, ~4× faster gen, full-mesh elevator, unified sky-mass rock field — now with a guaranteed ledge band, a five-terrain plateau palette, and south-facing cliff faces that make the upper level read as elevated.
body:
# As above, So below II — V2

> V1 is **DELETED**. Current tree: ~58 files / ~12,700 LOC.

## Pitch
Three z-levels (sky / surface / basement) in ONE RimWorld `Map`. Priorities: (1) visual clarity from the sky, (2) performance, (3) full vanilla parity.

---

# 1. ARCHITECTURE
One `Map`, size `(w, 1, bandCount × Slot)`; bands along **+z**; permanently-fogged gutter between bands; `Slot = ceil((bandHeight+2)/64)×64` — **64-alignment is load-bearing**. Map sizes curated (126 / 190 / 254).

### The one insight
`Region.Neighbors` is **topological, not spatial**. Wormhole `RegionLink`s between one-cell `RegionType.Portal` ends conduct connectivity without merging rooms/temperature/vacuum; `Reachability.CanReach` works **unpatched** — we patch nothing in `Reachability`/`PathFinder`/region traversal.

### Dividing line
Graph/logic = FREE. Geometry/presentation = NOT free; fix per draw/compute site. Reachability-as-proxy consumers (wander roots fixed; joy/meditation/pens un-audited).

### Hard 1.6 constraints
Jobified pathfinder · no `PathFinder.FindPath` · `BlocksDiagonalMovement` trips on unwalkable cells.

### Generation-window rules
Carve in `GenerateContentsIntoMap` postfix · `TryPendingSurfaceRect` for genstep-time band math · start-spot clamp + `RescueStrandedColonists` + `CarveStartClearing` on zero-standable surfaces (also fires on ocean tiles; "solid rock" wording is a mislabel).

# 2. ⚠ THE LOAD BOUNDARY (root-caused, fix pending verification)
Cache poisoning: `ConstructComponents()` creates a transient EMPTY `ABBandMap` that mid-load rendering latches. Fix: `CompOf` never caches while `Scribe.mode != Inactive` + `FinalizeInit` rebinds all caches. Also: uniqueID-keyed statics → CWT; load camera move deferred. **Verify: menu-load · load-while-playing · double cycle.**

# 3. PER-BAND BIOME / CAVERNS — verified
`GetBiomeAt` prefix (cell param) · sky biome locked to surface · `SeedFlora` on plateau cells · Biomes! Caverns basements. Watch: perf-mod biome caching · stalagmite leak · Earthen Depths temp.

# 4. CAMERA — verified. `viewBand` · `CurrentViewRect` clip · `ABBandCurtain` = `MapEdgeMaterial` at WorldClipper altitude.

# 5. MAP GEN — ~4× faster, closed (crowdedness mechanism; doomed-band plant skip).

# 6. RUNTIME PERF — 59.6 fps @96 pawns, mod ≈2% frame. Every visual system is bake-time section-mesh geometry: zero per-frame cost.

# 7. SEE-BELOW / BORDER STACK
Event-driven sky sync; below-draw prints + translates (one big map, no DrawPos lies). Shared `ABNineFan` (vanilla 9-vert cell fan). Below fog = vanilla corner smoothing sampled one band down · below edge shadows via shared `ABEdgeShadowGeometry` (ONE verbatim copy, three callers) · meadow fade = neighbour ground's own world-position material as a fade fan over the mass cell · rooftop fade via TerrainHard→TerrainFadeRough shader-swapped clone + AlphaAddTex (**shader assignment resets renderQueue — set queue after**) · drop-off EdgeShadow ring in open-air cells bordering the mass.

# 8. SKY-MASS PRESENTATION (mockup-driven; user chose A+B → D → E)
Design options were mocked up in `docs/mockups/ledge-options.html` (real vanilla pixels cropped from playtest screenshots + honest feasibility/perf scoring). Chosen order: **A+B now**, D next, E after a water spike, C parked.

**Unification (shipped earlier, still the foundation).** v1 "cover" (atlas tiles above cutout+fog) was a **shipped regression** — queue-above-everything erased overhanging sprites (tree tops, plants) and mask-15 interiors read as a flat slab. Replaced by **conceal-by-not-drawing**:
- `Patch_Thing_Print_ABSkyMassRock` — `Thing.Print` prefix (single choke point; Mineable doesn't override) withholds sky-band plain-rock sprites. Mining/selection/designations/link-masks untouched.
- `Patch_SectionLayer_FogOfWar_ABSkyMassScope` — replaced Regenerate recomputes vanilla's 9-vert colours with one predicate change (fogged && sky-mass ⇒ clear). Fog DATA untouched; other bands byte-identical; uses `FogGrid.IsFogged` (no Unity.Collections ref).
- `ABSkyMassShadowScope` — EdgeShadows + internal SunShadows replaced on banded maps; sky-mass rock casts nothing INTO the mass; silhouette shadows kept; exception ⇒ vanilla fallback.
- Field underlay: every mass cell gets the rock's `naturalTerrain` (rough stone) material, world-position sampled, uv-FREE quads at `lowQueue`; atlas edge tiles only when mask≠15 at `lowQueue+1`; visible ore prints natively.

**Option A — terrace ring + plateau palette (2026-07-29).**
- **Ledge band ≥1 cell is an invariant, not a patch**: plateau requires `edgeDist ≥ 2` and `TerraceWidth()` never returns <1, so no plateau/wall cell can touch a non-mass cell. Documented in `ABSkyBandGen` — the renderer's silhouette lip and cliff face both depend on it.
- **Five-terrain plateau palette** driven by fertility noise × an INDEPENDENT moisture Perlin (so damp ≠ merely fertile): rock's own rough stone (bare shoulders) → gravel → soil → **rich soil** where moisture peaks → **mud** in the wettest hollows only (>0.90, deliberately rare). All are natural + FadeRough, so **vanilla blends every ground↔ground boundary for free**; our fan only handles ground↔rock-field.

**Option B — south-facing cliff face (2026-07-29).** `CliffFaceDepth = 2` (0 disables, dev A/B). The mass' southern rim cells carry a vertical brightness ramp — `FaceDarkest 0.42` at the band's bottom edge → full brightness at its top — applied to the field quad, the atlas edge tile AND the corner fillers, so one continuous gradient reads as a wall instead of the tile repainting the face. **Vertex colour multiplies the terrain shader, so rock detail stays visible down the whole face** (not a flat painted tone). `FaceDepthAt` walks south, gutter never counts as a drop.
**Why the face lives inside the mass cells** (not projected into the air cell below): open-air cells are where the see-below view prints surface content at the cutout queue, so geometry there would be overdrawn by a surface tree — or, if out-queued, would repeat the cover regression. Clipping to cells we already own is immune to queue AND depth contests. Cost: a taller-than-2-cell face isn't available without re-opening that fight.

# 9. VERTICAL LINKS — elevator SHIPPED (untested). Full-mesh 2×2 `AB2_Elevator`; shaft collapse; legacy-save migration. Known: `Carry` latent hole.

# 10. BETTER MOUNTAINS COMPAT — code-complete, co-load test deferred. Variant mode (silhouette-only sprites) + live-graphic caches + live `ABMinedRockLookup` colour + field uses BM-rebuilt naturalTerrain graphics live.

# 11. DIAGNOSTICS
band info · transit health · below pawn report · stuck probe · watchdog (verdict-contradiction unfixed) · transit logging · below layer report · lighting report · bisect toggles · biome report · shader report · ABGenProfile · cap corner filler toggle · `CliffFaceDepth`.

# 12. OPEN WORK
1. **Verify A+B**: cliff faces read as walls on south rims (tune `CliffFaceDepth` 1 vs 2 and `FaceDarkest`) · no dark banding on non-rim cells · plateau shows 5 distinct grounds with vanilla fades · rich soil/mud present but rare · ledge band never absent · plants/sprites unaffected.
2. **Verify reload fix** (menu-load, load-while-playing, double cycle).
3. **Verify elevator**.
4. **Option D — alpine plateau** (next): per-biome flora sets, scree/boulder scatter near rim, tarns interior-only (never within N cells of a drop), optional snow line. **Needs a density budget + measured gen delta** — plant spawning was the gen cost driver (16.9 s → 4.2 s).
5. **Option E — waterfalls** (after D): river raised to sky band at gen, lower level filled to mountain perimeter, fall lip = raised water adjacent to `ShowsBelow`, mist flecks (capped + zoom-gated) + sustainer. **Do the water spike FIRST**: put water on the sky band and view it from above — below-view water rendering is the unproven risk.
6. Option C (stepped mesa) parked · COMBAT never verified · mountain sun-shadow onto surface (parked) · vertical conduit · compat audit · transplant · reachability-proxy audit.

# 13. LESSONS (telegraphic)
Measure, don't reason · crowdedness drives destroy cost · reuse the engine's object · fog softness lives in EXPLORED neighbours' fans · classify terrain by PROPERTY not def identity · **conceal by NOT drawing (print suppression + fog-colour re-predicate) + low-queue field — NEVER a queue-above-cutout cover: it clips every overhanging sprite and mask-15 is near-flat** · **clip custom geometry to cells you already own; geometry in cells shared with sprites is a queue fight you lose either way** · **vertex colour on terrain materials dims the real texture (multiply) — use it for shading gradients instead of painting flat tones** · to replace a vanilla SectionLayer's output, prefix-return-false Regenerate and re-emit filtered · statics keyed by game-scoped ids leak — CWT · never cache comps while Scribe active · FinalizeInit = worker thread · altitude ≠ draw order but IS the cutout depth tiebreaker · material.shader assignment resets renderQueue · green build proves nothing about reflectively-instantiated classes · build-once caches go stale under settings-reapplying mods · **when art is locked in asset bundles, playtest screenshots are a legitimate mockup source**.

# 14. PUBLISHING
Store page honest (update after verification). known-issues.json v2 (no-elevator + hard-fog-squares entries stale). Live item **3773267907**.

## TESTING RULE
`isolated=true`. Companions: `astryl.Circinus` + `astryl.ModernDevTools` + `BiomesTeam.BiomesCaverns` + `BiomesTeam.CoreFramework` (+ BM only for compat runs). New colony for banding; reload tests need load-while-playing. Transit logging + watchdog reset every launch.
